questions.q: Define a "control valve".
options: The value set on the scale of the control system in order to obtain the required condition
The quantity or condition of the controlled medium
The flow or pressure of the steam (or fluid) being manipulated
The valve of the controlled condition actually maintained under steady-state conditions
questions.answer: The valve of the controlled condition actually maintained under steady-state conditions

questions.q: A pneumatic temperature control is used on the steam supply to a non-storage heat exchanger that heats water serving an office heating system. What is referred to as the "manipulated variable"?
options: The water being heated
The air signal from the controller to the valve actuator
The steam supply
The temperature of the air being heated
questions.answer: The steam supply

questions.q: Which of the following valves is designed to allow a fluid to pass through in one direction?
options: Globe valve
Float valve
Gate valve
Check valve
questions.answer: Check valve

questions.q: How do you classify a solenoid valve?
options: A thermal valve
A bellows valve
A magnetic stop valve
A bimetallic valve
questions.answer: A magnetic stop valve

questions.q: What is a thermostat?
options: A temperature-operated switch
A pressure-operated switch
A superheat-operated switch
A back-pressure-operated switch
questions.answer: A temperature-operated switch

questions.q: Balanced pressure traps are what type of steam trap?
options: Thermodynamic
Mechanical
Thermostatic
They do not belong to any specific type of trap family
questions.answer: Thermostatic

questions.q: What is a characteristic feature of thermodynamic steam traps?
options: They pass condensate at steam temperature
They operate by holding back condensate until it has cooled
They cannot be fitted outside
They can only be fitted on low-pressure steam systems
questions.answer: They pass condensate at steam temperature

questions.q: What are the main considerations for steam trap selection?
options: Price
Air venting, plant performance, flow capacity, and reliability
Connections
The trap must be the same size as the condensate drain line
questions.answer: Air venting, plant performance, flow capacity, and reliability

questions.q: Can temperature-controlled applications be trapped?
options: Traps should not be fitted under any circumstances
Only if there is no lift after the trap
If the pressure on the trap is always higher than back pressure
Pumps should always be fitted to remove condensate
questions.answer: If the pressure on the trap is always higher than back pressure

questions.q: Unless they are designed to flood, what is important when removing condensate from heat exchangers?
options: Condensate is allowed to sub-cool before reaching the trap
Condensate is removed at steam temperature
Condensate should back up into the steam pipe
The trap is fitted level with or above the heater outlet
questions.answer: Condensate is removed at steam temperature

questions.q: How is flash steam produced?
options: From condensate passing from high to low pressure systems
From saturated steam
From superheated steam
From steam mixed with high-temperature air
questions.answer: From condensate passing from high to low pressure systems

questions.q: Are steam traps required to pass air?
options: Steam traps should not pass air under any circumstances
Only when the trap has passed all the condensate
Air should be removed as soon as it reaches the trap
Only on high-pressure steam systems
questions.answer: Air should be removed as soon as it reaches the trap

questions.q: How do you call a system employing open sprinklers attached to a piping system connected to a water supply through a valve opened by the operation of a fire detection system installed in the same area as the sprinklers?
options: Mechanical sprinkler
Wet pipe system
Automatic system
Deluge system
questions.answer: Deluge system

questions.q: What is probably the first consideration when selecting a control system?
options: What degree of accuracy is required?
Is the control for heating or cooling?
Is a two- or three-port valve required?
In the event of power failure, must the valve fail-open or fail-closed?
questions.answer: In the event of power failure, must the valve fail-open or fail-closed?

questions.q: It is a device designed to control the flow of steam, water, gas, or other fluids. It can be considered a variable orifice positioned by an actuator in response to impulses or signals from the controller, equipped with a throttling plug, V-port, or rotating ball. How do you call this device?
options: Automatic valve
Thermostat
Automatic flow meter
Pyrometer
questions.answer: Automatic valve

questions.q: Name one characteristic feature of mechanical steam traps.
options: They pass condensate at steam temperature
They operate by sensing condensate temperature
They can be fitted into any position
They are not affected by increasing back pressure
questions.answer: They pass condensate at steam temperature

questions.q: In a mechanical steam trap, why is a float trap better at venting air than an inverted bucket trap?
options: A float can quickly adjust to the presence of air
A float is fitted with an automatic air vent
A float trap does not vent air better than a bucket trap
The air vent orifice is adjustable on a float trap
questions.answer: A float is fitted with an automatic air vent

questions.q: In a mechanical steam trap, what added benefit does the automatic air vent offer to a float trap?
options: It stops the trap from freezing in cold weather
The trap can be used on larger backpressures
It significantly increases the cold start-up capacity of the trap
The condensate orifice can be the same size for all pressure ranges
questions.answer: It significantly increases the cold start-up capacity of the trap

questions.q: In a mechanical steam trap, what advantage does a bucket trap have over a float type?
options: It is able to withstand waterhammer
It can be used on higher pressure
It can discharge air freely
It cannot lose its water seal
questions.answer: It can be used on higher pressure

questions.q: A heat exchanger is designed to operate without waterlogging of the steam space. What is the usual choice of trap for its drainage?
options: Thermostatic trap
Inverted bucket trap
Thermodynamic trap
Float trap with thermostatic air vent
questions.answer: Float trap with thermostatic air vent

questions.q: Which is the best trap to use when steam locking can occur?
options: An inverted bucket trap with an internal check valve mechanism
A balanced pressure steam trap
A float trap with automatic air vent
A float trap with steam lock release mechanism
questions.answer: A float trap with steam lock release mechanism

questions.q: What is a common cause of waterhammer in drying coils?
options: Wet steam supplied to the coil
Too low a steam pressure onto the coil
Condensate has to lift after the steam trap
The coil falling in the direction of steam flow
questions.answer: Condensate has to lift after the steam trap

questions.q: Which of the following statements is true?
options: Bimetallic steam traps are an ideal choice for rotating cylinders
Rotating cylinders cannot suffer from steam locking
Strainers cannot be fitted to float traps which have a steam lock release
Air vents around thermodynamic and inverted bucket traps can considerably improve start-up times
questions.answer: Air vents around thermodynamic and inverted bucket traps can considerably improve start-up times

questions.q: What effect does steam locking have on rotating machinery?
options: None at all
It reduces the drying rate of drying cylinders
It increases the drying rate of drying cylinders
It causes the steam trap to air bind
questions.answer: It reduces the drying rate of drying cylinders

questions.q: The first step to take in planning a preventive maintenance program is to:
options: Replace all electric wiring
Make an equipment inventory
Replace all pump seals
Repair all equipment which is not in operation
questions.answer: Make an equipment inventory

questions.q: Which of the following is the most important consideration in a fire prevention program?
options: Train the staff to place flammables in fireproof containers
Know how to attack fires regardless of size
See that halls, corridors, and exits are not blocked
Detect and eliminate every possible fire hazard
questions.answer: Detect and eliminate every possible fire hazard

questions.q: Which of the following types of portable fire extinguisher is recommended as most effective for putting out oil fires?
options: Pump tank type
Cartridge-actuated type
Soda acid type
Foam type
questions.answer: Foam type

questions.q: Assume that one of your assistants was near a Freon 11 refrigeration system when a liquid Freon line ruptured and some liquid got into his right eye. Of the following actions, the one which you should NOT take is to:
options: Immediately call for an eye doctor specialist (medical doctor)
Gently and quickly rub the Freon 11 out of the eye
Use a boric-acid solution to clean out the Freon 11 from his eye
Wash the eye by gently blowing the Freon 11 out of his eye with air
questions.answer: Gently and quickly rub the Freon 11 out of the eye

questions.q: In accordance with recommended maintenance practice, thermostats used in a pneumatic temperature control system should be checked:
options: Weekly
Monthly
Bi-monthly
Once a year
questions.answer: Once a year

questions.q: In a thermal plant, name the components of a self-acting temperature control system.
options: Control valve and actuator
Control valve, actuator, and sensor
Control valve, actuator, capillary tube, and sensor
Control valve, actuator, and capillary tube
questions.answer: Control valve, actuator, capillary tube, and sensor

questions.q: What is the purpose of over-temperature protection within a self-acting control system?
options: To protect the valve from high-temperature steam
To protect the liquid fill in the capillary from boiling
To protect the control system from irreversible damage
To protect the application from overtemperature
questions.answer: To protect the control system from irreversible damage

questions.q: Why are three-port self-acting control valves used in an industrial steam thermal system?
options: To mix or divert liquids, especially water
To dump steam to waste under fault conditions
Where cooling applications are required
When large valves are required to meet large capacities
questions.answer: To mix or divert liquids, especially water

questions.q: Name one disadvantage of a direct-acting pressure reducing valve.
options: It only has proportional control
It has proportional and integral control but no derivative control
It operates in an on/off fashion
An external power source is required for it to operate
questions.answer: It only has proportional control
